description: pkix-ct/src/lib.rs: verify_scts always returns Err(Error::NoScts). NoScts means the cert contains no SCT extension — a meaningful, actionable status. A caller who passes a cert that DOES have SCTs will get NoScts back, which is factually false. The function is unimplemented; it should return a distinct variant or panic with 'not implemented', not a status code that callers will misinterpret as a real cert evaluation. Future integration code that branches on this error will silently behave incorrectly when the function is eventually implemented.
title: verify_scts returns NoScts instead of NotImplemented
